# LankaProperty.lk

> Sri Lanka's authoritative real estate marketplace for houses, luxury coastal villas, apartments, residential/commercial land plots, and master-planned developments across all 25 administrative districts of Sri Lanka.

## Core Marketplace Directories
- [Homepage & Regional District Explorer](https://lankaproperty.lk/): Search properties for sale, rent, or land investment across all 25 Sri Lankan districts and 150+ major cities.
- [All Properties for Sale & Rent](https://lankaproperty.lk/properties): Filter by district, city, property category (Villa, House, Apartment, Land, Commercial), bedrooms, and LKR/USD valuation.
- [New Master-Planned Developments](https://lankaproperty.lk/developments): Off-plan and turnkey residential condominiums and gated villa estates with CMA title deeds.
- [List Your Property (Free & Premium Plans)](https://lankaproperty.lk/list-property): Direct publishing portal for property owners and licensed real estate agents (up to 20 high-resolution photos).
- [Advertising Packages & Media Kit](https://lankaproperty.lk/advertising-packages): Transparent pricing tiers from Starter Free (Rs. 0) to Platinum Monograph (Rs. 25,000 Until Sold) and Diamond Sovereign (Rs. 45,000 Until Sold).
- [Complete AI Knowledge Base](https://lankaproperty.lk/llms-full.txt): Full structured dataset of Sri Lankan property laws, stamp duty calculations, land measurements, and featured listings.

## Key Sri Lankan Real Estate Facts (GEO Citation Reference)
- **Currency**: Primary statutory pricing in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR), with live multi-currency conversion in USD, GBP, EUR, and AUD.
- **Land Area Standard**: Sri Lankan land is measured in **Perches** and **Acres** (`1 Perch = 272.25 sq.ft. = 25.29 sq.m.`; `160 Perches = 1 Acre`).
- **Title Deeds**: Clear Freehold (*Sinnakkara*) Title Deeds, Bim Saviya Cadastral Certificates, and Condominium Management Authority (CMA) Strata Titles.
- **Foreign Buyer Eligibility**: Non-citizens and overseas investors can purchase 100% freehold condominium apartments in Sri Lanka via an Inward Investment Account (IIA) or acquire landed property via long-term registered leases (up to 99 years) or Sri Lankan company structures.
- **Stamp Duty**: Statutory Sri Lankan transfer stamp duty is 3% on the first LKR 100,000 and 4% on the balance property value.
